inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: H1 FY2026 interim EPS note, weighted basic 2,579.7m + restricted shares 6.1m + options 0.1m = 2,586.0m; shares on issue 2,586.1m. Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows. No buyback since FY2023 (RMB1,159m that year), so the flat count is a modelling convention, not currently funded by repurchases; SBC is small (~0.5% of revenue).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual cash-flow reconciliation (2331.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:10203-10206): equity-settled share option and restricted share award expense RMB240.661m less forfeiture reversal RMB167.885m = net RMB72.8m add-back inside OCF. No net-share-settlement tax line (equity-award taxes nil). Forward charge is projected at 0.5% of revenue, roughly the FY2022-25 gross average, NOT the reversal-depressed net, so forfeiture credits (FY2025 167.9m, H1 FY2026 210.4m) are not capitalised.
inputs.interest_income_note: Set to 0 deliberately: Li Ning classifies interest received (RMB882m FY2025, lumpy because time-deposit interest lands at maturity) in INVESTING activities and strips 'finance income - net' out of OCF (FY2025 AR line 10200, 10255). Reported FCF (OCF - capex) therefore already excludes interest; deducting FY2025 finance income of RMB296.7m again would double-strip. The forward build starts from operating profit, which is also below-the-line of finance income; WMP redemption gains (RMB65m FY2025) were also removed from the EBITDA anchor.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1724 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T22:01Z. No dual listing to parity-check against; the interim report converts dividends at the PBoC official rate but does not print the number. Sense check: market cap HK$34.3bn / 1.1724 = RMB29.3bn against RMB28.7bn book equity, i.e. ~1.0x P/B, consistent with the stock's 52-week low region. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; re-pull it on any price refresh.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z regular close (Friday HKEX session; Yahoo chart API)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity in CNY, no financial debt (RMB14.1bn facilities undrawn): China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.1 x ERP ~7.0% (China mature ERP plus country premium) = ~9.5%. Leases are in the flows (treatment B), so WACC = CoE. Same 9.5% in every scenario; risk is charged in the flows/weights, not in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash payment (principal + interest; RMB728.3m FY2025, RMB415.0m H1 FY2026, both in financing as 'payment of principal and related interest of lease liabilities') deducted via lease_cost_pct_path (2.46% FY2025, 2.72% H1 FY2026). Lease liabilities (RMB1,979m at 30-Jun-2026) EXCLUDED from net debt (total_debt = 0; the company has no bank debt). da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: 1,376.1 total - 498.1 RoU = 878.0, 2.97% of revenue, includes investment-property depreciation since rental income stays in the flows).
inputs.nci_treatment: Nil - NCI is immaterial (none in FY2024-25 equity). Flows are effectively attributable.
inputs.ebitda_anchor: FY2025 adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC, pre-lease, pre-impairment) = operating profit 3,898.2 + D&A 1,376.1 + non-cash impairments 701.1 (RoU 283.4, PPE 72.3, investment property 269.0, intangibles/goodwill 76.4) + net SBC 72.8 - WMP gains 65.1 = 5,983 = 20.2% of revenue. RoU/PPE store impairments recur, but they are non-cash: the lease cash and the capex are both charged in full, so adding them back is not a double count. Government grants (RMB413.6m, 1.4% of revenue) are recurring PRC local subsidies and are kept in EBITDA; a withdrawal is a bear-case risk.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, routed per dcf-methods SKILL.md as a non-US consumer operating company (owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md: CNY flows / HKD quote, IFRS-16 leases, net-cash with time deposits, small SBC). First valuation of this ticker; no prior model to match. Net cash RMB19,388.5m at 30-Jun-2026 = cash 13,003.3 + current time deposits 2,215.8 + non-current time deposits 4,169.4 (restricted deposits RMB2.4m excluded; WMPs were fully redeemed within H1 so none held at period end). Owner FCF anchor (FY2025) = reported FCF 3,559.8 (OCF 4,851.5 - capex 1,291.7) - net SBC 72.8 - interest 0 = 3,486.9; after the treatment-(B) lease payment of 728.3 the lease-adjusted figure is ~2,759, which is the comparable number for the year-1 projection (~2.6bn). H1 FY2026 OCF fell to RMB954m (from 2,411m) on cash marketing/tax and e-commerce settlement timing; base case treats most of that as timing, not a margin reset, since H1 operating profit was flat (+0.5%) and gross margin rose to 50.9%. Equity bridge adds non-operating assets whose income is excluded from operating profit (equity-method JVs/associates; FVPL investments) and deducts a debt-like licence payable and an operating-cash reserve.

equity_bridge.item: Investments accounted for using the equity method (Double Happiness, AIGLE China JV, Kason etc.) at book
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet line 1962; share of profit RMB257.9m FY2025 sits below operating profit so it is not in the flows. Book is ~6.9x that profit, conservative.
H1 FY2026 interim line 1963; income below operating profit

H1 FY2026 interim: 456.3 non-current + 47.3 current; new capitalised licence (intangibles rose 424m in H1, consistent with the Curry Brand partnership). Payments run through financing/investing, not EBITDA, so treated as debt-like.
Judgment: a retailer/wholesaler with ~RMB4bn of other payables and seasonal working capital cannot distribute every yuan of its cash pile; held back from the net-cash credit.

equity_bridge.item: Legacy litigation expected value (Active Legend / Vast Gold HK$500m+ claim)
equity_bridge.note: ~RMB460m claim x ~25% probability; management asserts no repayment obligation, case management conference Sept 2026

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR (4.3%) diverges sharply from EPS 3yr CAGR (-9.9%): book keeps growing because only ~50% of earnings is paid out while EPS has fallen from the FY2021-22 China-chic peak. Equity 5yr CAGR (26.0%) is distorted by the FY2021 top-up placing and is not used.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC (interest 0 throughout; interest received is an investing flow for this filer). FCF CAGRs are flattered by a FY2022 trough base (RMB1.73bn reported, inventory build) and are not a growth signal. Owner-FCF CAGR is above reported because SBC fell as a share of FCF, the reverse of the dilution warning case. Revenue 5yr CAGR includes the 2021 boom (+56%); the 3yr 4.7% and FY2025 +3.2% / H1 FY2026 +2.8% describe the current business.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 2.5% sits just under H1 FY2026 +2.8% given management's 'weak demand' H2 tone; then ~3% nominal (China sportswear low-single-digit for the larger players) fading to 2.5%.
base.margin_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC/lease/impairment) held at 20.0% vs 20.2% FY2025: H1 FY2026 gross margin gain offset by heavier Olympic/Curry marketing and promotional intensity. Lease 2.6% between FY2025 2.46% and H1 FY2026 2.72%.
base.capex_rationale: 4.5% FY2026 carries the Guangxi base (RMB3.3bn plan, RMB2.1bn already in assets) and Loong Store rollout, tapering to 3.5% ~ 1.1x D&A ex-RoU.
base.tax_rationale: 28% cash: 25% PRC CIT plus withholding on cross-border dividend upstreaming (FY2025 ETR 29.9%, FY2024 26.7%; cash tax paid RMB1,220m FY2025).
base.wc_rationale: Negative capture: receivables + inventory (RMB4.0bn) exceed trade payables (RMB1.9bn), so growth consumes cash.

bull.rationale: Demand inflection from 2027 plus running/basketball share gains; margin recovers toward but stays below the FY2021-22 peak (FY2022 pre-lease EBITDA ~24.6%) on operating leverage and better full-price sell-through.

bear.rationale: Anta multi-brand and Nike/Adidas recovery squeeze the mid-premium middle; revenue declines in FY2027-28 with deleveraging fixed costs, deeper discounting and channel mix toward lower-margin wholesale; government grants fade.

scenario_narratives.base: Li Ning grinds along as a mature, net-cash, single-brand domestic sportswear company: low-single-digit revenue growth in line with a China sportswear market that has slowed to low/mid-single digits for the large players, gross-margin gains from Super BOOM-led running and the Olympic-partner premium line roughly offset by Olympic-cycle and Curry Brand marketing and a promotional retail environment, store network flat (~7,600 POS) with direct retail rationalised and franchise/e-commerce growing. Owner FCF of ~RMB2.6bn/yr after leases, a ~50% payout continues, and the H1 FY2026 operating-cash-flow drop proves to be settlement and tax timing rather than a margin reset.
scenario_narratives.bull: The China sportswear demand inflection that the sell-side expects in 2026-27 arrives: Super BOOM Capsule and the marathon credibility translate into running share gains, the Curry partnership and Glory Gold Label rebuild basketball and premium pricing, outdoor/tennis/pickleball add incremental categories, and Loong Store formats lift same-store productivity. Revenue compounds 5-7% for several years and adjusted EBITDA margin recovers about 3pp toward the FY2021-22 China-chic peak, without reaching it.
scenario_narratives.bear: Scale wins: Anta (~2.7x Li Ning's revenue, multi-brand across Fila/Descente/Kolon) and recovering Nike/Adidas China squeeze the mid-premium middle where a single brand sits, while the 'strong supply, weak demand' consumer environment management flagged in H1 FY2026 persists. Revenue falls in FY2027-28 as franchisees destock, discounting deepens, the mix shifts further to lower-margin wholesale, and fixed store and marketing costs deleverage; margins settle about 3.5pp below FY2025. The net-cash balance sheet means this is an earnings and value problem, not a solvency one.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: ~98.6% China exposure, a single brand facing a 2.7x-larger multi-brand rival, management's own 'weak demand' commentary and the H1 FY2026 OCF drop. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs a macro demand inflection, share gains against Anta and Nike, and margin recovery all at once. Base 50%: H1 FY2026 revenue +2.8% and flat operating profit are the run-rate. No solvency tail (net cash ~65% of market cap), so bear is not raised further.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Li Ning as a mature, ex-growth-but-cash-generative Chinese sportswear brand: owner FCF after leases and fully-expensed SBC, discounted at a CNY cost of equity, with the large net-cash and deposit pile credited separately (less an operating reserve). The question the price poses is whether the business is in structural decline; the base case says no, the bear case says slow erosion.
key_risks_to_valuation: Share loss to Anta's multi-brand portfolio and to a Nike/Adidas China recovery
Chinese discretionary consumption and property wealth effect; promotional intensity compressing gross margin
H1 FY2026 operating cash flow collapse (RMB954m vs 2,411m) proving structural rather than timing
Government grants (~1.4% of revenue) and favourable local tax treatment withdrawn
Capital allocation: the cash pile is credited to shareholders, but has not been bought back since FY2023; a large acquisition or Guangxi overrun would dissipate it
CNY/HKD rate: every RMB value is translated at a single dated rate
